boundary_condition: Apply only to flight-stop selection; do not infer any reusable preference about airline, cabin, destination, date, or party size from this habit.
condition: When searching for flight itineraries for a trip, if a straight/nonstop option is available for the requested route and date.
default_action: Search for and prefer straight/nonstop flights before considering itineraries with stops.
exception_condition: If no straight/nonstop flight satisfies the required trip constraints, present flights with stops as fallback options and ask for confirmation rather than silently booking one.
name: Defaults to straight flights
rationale: Across three independent Taskmaster instruction_ids, the user request repeatedly specifies or prefers a straight flight. This supports a controlled synthetic default for avoiding stops, without treating any route or date as habitual.

source_evidence.contribution: instruction_id flight-6: The user says, "No, I prefer a straight flight," directly grounding a straight/nonstop preference.
instruction_id flight-13: The user says, "I want it to be a straight flight," supporting a default to avoid stops.
instruction_id flight-4: The user specifies "Economy seating, straight flight," grounding straight as the desired flight-stops value.
